g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: Isolated trigger input and photodiode front end

g.desc: Title: Isolated trigger input and photodiode front end

g.text: Sheet: /Isolated trigger input and photodiode front end/

g.desc: Sheet: /Isolated trigger input and photodiode front end/

g.text: 3.0-5.0 V logic lights the TLP2761 LED through 620R; D600 clamps reverse polarity. Output to TRIGGER_ISO for timer capture.

g.desc: 3.0-5.0 V logic lights the TLP2761 LED through 620R; D600 clamps reverse polarity. Output to TRIGGER_ISO for timer capture.

g.text: TLV7011 with 1M hysteresis feedback drives PHOTO_EDGE for timer capture.

g.desc: TLV7011 with 1M hysteresis feedback drives PHOTO_EDGE for timer capture.

g.text: Photodiode: passive sensor only (e.g. BPW34). Not isolated: treat as participant-side like the electrodes. TIA Vout = 50 mV + Iph x 33k; DAC POR code 0 = no edges until calibrated.

g.desc: Photodiode: passive sensor only (e.g. BPW34). Not isolated: treat as participant-side like the electrodes. TIA Vout = 50 mV + Iph x 33k; DAC POR code 0 = no edges until calibrated.

g.text: Trigger input 3.0-5.0 V logic, active high, 2-6 mA LED current. U600 inverts: trigger high gives TRIGGER_ISO low; firmware captures both edges.

g.desc: Trigger input 3.0-5.0 V logic, active high, 2-6 mA LED current. U600 inverts: trigger high gives TRIGGER_ISO low; firmware captures both edges.

g.text: ISOLATION BARRIER: J600, R600, D600 and U600 pins 1-3 are the isolated side. Keep >= 8 mm creepage and clearance to all other copper (slot under U600). J600 shell is not board GND.

g.desc: ISOLATION BARRIER: J600, R600, D600 and U600 pins 1-3 are the isolated side. Keep >= 8 mm creepage and clearance to all other copper (slot under U600). J600 shell is not board GND.

g.text: EVENT INPUTS - EDGES TIMESTAMPED BY THE MCU TIMER (GPIOTE + PPI), SAME PATH AS ADC DRDY

g.desc: EVENT INPUTS - EDGES TIMESTAMPED BY THE MCU TIMER (GPIOTE + PPI), SAME PATH AS ADC DRDY

g.text: Passive photodiode into TLV9061, 33k || 15 pF feedback; output also to SAADC (PHOTO_MONITOR) for threshold calibration.

g.desc: Passive photodiode into TLV9061, 33k || 15 pF feedback; output also to SAADC (PHOTO_MONITOR) for threshold calibration.

g.text: MCP4725 on the power I2C bus (0x60) sets the comparator threshold through a 1k/100 nF filter.

g.desc: MCP4725 on the power I2C bus (0x60) sets the comparator threshold through a 1k/100 nF filter.
